scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: The club receives a message using the teacher’s picture. It promises a prize, demands a sign-in code within two minutes and supplies a new checking number. Meera and Kabir recognise earlier clues instead of trusting its picture.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: The picture is an identity claim, the prize is a reward claim and the deadline creates pressure. The login code is the action being requested. None of these details independently confirms that the teacher sent the message, even though the whole story appears to fit together.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The team pauses, asks through the existing school channel and keeps a short fictional note of the request. If a classmate already shared something, they offer calm help. Their final explanation connects each clue to a response without making unsupported accusations or promising a guaranteed outcome.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: The message combines a copied-looking picture, urgent reward, sign-in code demand and new contact number. No independent check exists. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.

scenes.dialogue: Which response uses the full evidence?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: Pause without sharing the code and ask the teacher through the existing school channel. Preserve the useful request details for help rather than treating the supplied number as verification.

scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through connect the clues, then verify independently, then explain the response. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
